name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix + chapter domain + descriptor that accurately states content (FDOTHER.DAT resource index for the chapter intro panel, selected per metadata category) and data shape (_table). No Ghidra address residue; the only numerics are content values, not address suffixes. Long but fully descriptive.
purpose: Per-metadata-category lookup giving the FDOTHER.DAT sub-file index of the chapter-intro panel sprite (RLE background) shown during the chapter-intro menu of story chapters.
logic_summary: 3-entry const byte table {0x0B,0x3D,0x3E}. Sole reader fd2_chapter_transition_menu copies all 3 bytes byte-by-byte into a stack-local scratch then indexes table[metadata[0]-2], where metadata[0] is the chapter category byte from fd2_get_chapter_intro_metadata_entry(current_chapter_id). Result is passed to fd2_load_dat_resource("FDOTHER.DAT", idx): category 2->0x0B, 3->0x3D, 4->0x3E.
element_semantics: Each element is an unsigned FDOTHER.DAT sub-file (resource) index. element[0]=category 2 panel (0x0B), element[1]=category 3 panel (0x3D), element[2]=category 4 panel (0x3E). Indexed by (chapter metadata category byte - 2).
comment_original_issue: Original src comment was slightly imprecise: it said the table is indexed 'by metadata[0] (stored via base -2 in the source)', which obscures that the actual access is table[metadata[0]-2] (category 2/3/4 -> entry 0/1/2). Refined to state the index expression and the explicit category->resource mapping.
notes: Verified read-only: get_xrefs_to shows only fd2_chapter_transition_menu (DATA @ 0x2CAF7 + READ @ 0x2CAFC), no writers -> const confirmed. read_memory(0x526D7,3)={0x0b,0x3d,0x3e} matches src and Ghidra DT byte[3] len=3.
